question:
What should come in place of ? in the given series based on the English alphabetical order?

LPA, PSY, TVW, XYU, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter → (4) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (3) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​​So,

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f51ebe59addf719edbbb63fa3eff93bd089d5950d61785c711214dd6bb418102.png] 

Hence, "**BBS**" is the correct answer.

b2:T
